title: Plan archive extraction without path alias escapes
instruction: Harden plan_extraction(members) as a filesystem-free archive containment planner. members must be a list of exact records with name and type, where type is file or dir. Treat slash and backslash as separators on every platform; reject empty, absolute, drive-prefixed, NUL, empty-segment, dot, or parent paths and every unsupported link/device type. Normalize output to relative POSIX names, append slash only for directories, preserve input order, and reject duplicate or casefold-equivalent targets across files and directories. Validate the entire list before returning, never create files, and never mutate inputs. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 containment lineage using archive aliases, platform-independent paths, and type restrictions.
